arxiv-2101-11018.title: Accurate and Efficient Simulations of Hamiltonian Mechanical Systems with Discontinuous Potentials
arxiv-2101-11018.creator: Molei Tao, Shi Jin
arxiv-2101-11018.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Molei Tao, Shi Jin. This article considers Hamiltonian mechanical systems with potential functions admitting jump discontinuities. The focus is on accurate and efficient numerical approximations of their solutions, which will be defined via the laws of reflection and refraction. Despite of the success of symplectic integrators for smooth mechanical systems, their construction for the discontinuous ones is nontrivial, and numerical convergence order can be impaired too.

arxiv-2306-02536.title: A new method to constrain annihilating dark matter A new method to constrain annihilating dark matter – References XXXX
arxiv-2306-02536.creator: Man Ho Chan, Chak Man Lee
arxiv-2306-02536.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Man Ho Chan, Chak Man Lee. Recent indirect searches of dark matter using gamma-ray, radio, and cosmic-ray data have provided some stringent constraints on annihilating dark matter. In this article, we propose a new indirect method to constrain annihilating dark matter.

arxiv-2402-06513.title: Long-lived collective Rydberg excitations in atomic gas achieved via ac-Stark lattice modulation
arxiv-2402-06513.creator: Stanisław Kurzyna, Bartosz Niewelt, Mateusz Mazelanik, Wojciech Wasilewski, Michał Parniak
arxiv-2402-06513.description: Abstract Collective Rydberg excitations provide promising applications ranging from quantum information processing, and quantum computing to ultra-sensitive electrometry. However, their short lifetime is an immense obstacle in real-life scenarios. The state-of-the-art methods of prolonging the lifetime were mainly implemented for ground-state quantum memories and would require a redesign to effectively work on different atomic transitions.

arxiv-2407-17507.title: Phase transitions in q q -state clock model
arxiv-2407-17507.creator: Arpita Goswami, Ravi Kumar, Monikana Gope, Shaon Sahoo
arxiv-2407-17507.description: Abstract The q − q- state clock model, sometimes called the discrete X ​ Y XY model, is known to show a second-order (symmetry breaking) phase transition in two-dimension (2D) for q ≤ 4 q\leq 4 ( q = 2 q=2 corresponds to the Ising model).

arxiv-2503-03503.title: Collaborative Expert LLMs Guided Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
arxiv-2503-03503.creator: Jiajun Yu, Yizhen Zheng, Huan Yee Koh, Shirui Pan, Tianyue Wang, Haishuai Wang
arxiv-2503-03503.description: Abstract Molecular optimization is a crucial yet complex and time-intensive process that often acts as a bottleneck for drug development. Traditional methods rely heavily on trial and error, making multi-objective optimization both time-consuming and resource-intensive. Current AI-based methods have shown limited success in handling multi-objective optimization tasks, hampering their practical utilization.

arxiv-2506-17059.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Martin Cornejo, Melina Graner, Holger Hesse, Andreas Jossen, [0.1cm] Technical University of Munich, Germany; TUM School of Engineering, DesignDepartment of Energy and Process Engineering, Chair of Electrical Energy Storage Technology, [0.1cm] Kempten University of Applied Sciences, Germany; Institu. arxiv-2601-17767.title: HyCARD-Net: A Synergistic Hybrid Intelligence Framework for Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis
arxiv-2601-17767.creator: Rajan Das Gupta, Xiaobin Wu, Xun Liu *, Jiaqi He
arxiv-2601-17767.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Rajan Das Gupta, Xiaobin Wu, Xun Liu *, Jiaqi He. Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains the foremost cause of mortality worldwide, underscoring the urgent need for intelligent and data-driven diagnostic tools. Traditional predictive models often struggle to generalize across heterogeneous datasets and complex physiological patterns. To address this, we propose a hybrid ensemble framework that integrates deep learning architectures—Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)—with classical machine learning algorithms, including K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), using an ensemble voting mechanism.

pmc-10731365.title: Clinical markers predict the efficacy of several immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with non-small cell lung cancer in China
pmc-10731365.creator: Yuxin Wang, Jiahui Lu, Chenxi Wu, Fei Fei, Zhuze Chu, Peihua Lu
pmc-10731365.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectivesImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are one of the most significant oncological treatment modalities as a result of the rapid advancement of immunotherapy. Programmed Cell Death-Ligand 1 (PD-L1) and tumor mutational burden (TMB) have emerged as key markers for predicting the efficacy and prognosis of ICIs in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and the predictive role of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) has also received significant attention.

pmc-11451477.title: A Case of Necrotizing Fasciitis/Myositis and Streptococcal Toxic Shock Syndrome Caused by emm22/ST46 Strain of Streptococcus pyogenes
pmc-11451477.creator: Jia Zhang, Zhijian Wang, Yushan Jiang, Dan Zhang, Wanyan Den, Danni Wang, Jiayi Peng, Jiajun Li, Wenxiang Huang
pmc-11451477.description: Streptococcus pyogenes, also known as Group A Streptococcus (GAS), can cause severe invasive diseases with high fatality rates. We report a case of necrotizing fasciitis and myositis complicated by Streptococcal Toxic Shock-Like Syndrome (STSS) caused by the invasive emm22/ST46 strain of Streptococcus pyogenes in China.

pmc-11587648.title: Optimized production of a truncated form of the recombinant neuraminidase of influenza virus in Escherichia coli as host with suitable functional activity
pmc-11587648.creator: Fatemeh Sadat Shariati, Fatemeh Fotouhi, Behrokh Farahmand, Zahra Barghi, Kayhan Azadmanesh
pmc-11587648.description: BackgroundTo discover effective drugs for treating Influenza (a disease with high annual mortality), large amounts of recombinant neuraminidase (NA) with suitable catalytic activity are needed. However, the functional activity of the full-length form of this enzyme in the bacterial host (as producing cells with a low cost) in a soluble form is limited.

pmc-12567234.title: Prevalence and Risk Mapping of Intestinal Parasites in the “Hungry Valleys” Region of Slovakia
pmc-12567234.creator: Lukáš Ihnacik, Júlia Šmigová, Carmen Anthonj, Ingrid Papajová, Vyacheslav Yurchenko
pmc-12567234.description: Helminthiases remain a significant global health concern, affecting both the Global South and increasingly the Global North. In Slovakia, intestinal parasitic infections impact marginalised populations, particularly the population of Roma inhabitants, who often face inadequate housing, poor sanitation, and limited access to clean water.

pmc-13009368.title: Evaluation of UV/TiO2/H2O2 photocatalysis for the removal of perfluorinated organic compounds from water
pmc-13009368.creator: María Lizeth Marín Marín, Gustavo A Peñuela
pmc-13009368.description: Conventional processes do not eliminate PFAS in wastewater treatment plants, so they are found in trace concentrations in wastewater and rivers. Perfluorinated organic pollutants (PFAs) are toxic and persistent, that have a significant risk to human health and ecosystems. Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) is one of the most common PFAs to enter water bodies, and does so primarily through untreated wastewater.

pmc-13352826.title: Chronic activity-based anorexia triggers a glial response in the hippocampus independent of intestinal epithelial toll-like receptor 4
pmc-13352826.creator: Léna Rousseau, Tanguy Demangeat, Colin Salaün, Clara Queguiner, Charlène Guérin, Christine Bôle-Feysot, Oudiayé Maiga, Adam Tiffay, Fatima Léon, Léa Cornaille, David Ribet, Jean-Claude do Rego, Jean-Luc do Rego, Ludovic Langlois, Moïse Coëffier
pmc-13352826.description: Anorexia nervosa is characterized by maladaptive eating behavior and psychiatric comorbidities, which could be explained by a neuroinflammation. A gut dysbiosis could link gastrointestinal alterations to central dysfunctions, particularly via the toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), which has been shown to play a key role in the activity-based anorexia (ABA) model.

pmc-13471576.title: Training under planetary risk: planetary health ethics in clinical education and governance
pmc-13471576.creator: Animesh Ghimire, Mamata Sharma Neupane
pmc-13471576.description: BackgroundHealth-professional training in many low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) unfolds amid long-standing yet intensifying environmental, infrastructural, and health-system stressors, including extreme heat, unreliable power and water supplies, seasonal surges in vector-borne disease, and seismic risk. Yet undergraduate ethics teaching often remains encounter-centred, offering limited preparation for safe, fair, and role-bounded action when clinical systems are strained.
